consequential_endpoint.decision_time: after registered observations and before evaluator reveals truth
consequential_endpoint.policy: P(verify) is the posterior expected cross-cell severity clipped to [0,1]; P(proceed)=1-P(verify)

registered_rerun.consequential_cost_advantage_definition: factorized mean expected consequential cost minus joint mean expected consequential cost

decision_rule.belief_instrument_pass: primary factorization TV exceeds both 0.01 and the paired zero-strength control by 0.01
decision_rule.endpoint_consumption_pass: the action policy is a function of cross-cell mass and an equal-marginal interaction perturbation changes its action distribution
decision_rule.action_endpoint_pass: primary mean factorized-vs-joint consequential action-distribution TV is at least 0.01
decision_rule.directional_utility_benefit_pass: mean factorized-minus-joint expected consequential cost is at least 0.001
decision_rule.overall_task_pass: belief instrument pass AND endpoint consumption pass AND action endpoint pass AND directional utility benefit pass
